Title: Cancel blanket — HTTP 200 instead of 204 (REST inconsistency)
Expected: HTTP 204 (REST standard for no-content DELETE) — consistent with PUT /finalize and PUT /void which return 204
Actual: HTTP 200; cancel method has void return but no @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT) annotation, so Spring defaults to 200

Title: Add line with both lineDiscountAmount and lineDiscountPercent — amount takes silent precedence (no rejection)
Expected: Ideally HTTP 400 (mutually exclusive fields) or at least documentation of precedence rule
Actual: HTTP 201; both fields accepted; net=371852 = (2×186426.24 rounded) - 1000 amount (amount wins over percent silently); no error returned
